name: Admiral Somers' Shade

intro.text: Do you know why this island is called the Somers Isles? Because a man named Somers ran a ship onto it, rather than past it.
I have been told this was a navigation error. I prefer to say I discovered a very large rock the hard way.
Now. On your guard. I am an admiral, and I have not lost since 1609. The sea has, mind. Repeatedly.

win: Well sailed. The sea might owe you a favour.
after: They say my heart is buried here while the rest of me went home. I never asked for the split. Still, it's a nice spot.
